soldier: The head is yellowish brown, the mandibles purplish brown, the thorax and abdomen yellow. The head capsule is narrow and long, the head width index 0.48–0.53, the sides almost parallel, slightly constricted behind the antennal sockets, the posterior margin broadly rounded and projecting outwards. The frontal ridge is strongly raised, the frontal corners on both sides projecting, the interfrontal area shallowly concave, the anterior slope of the ridge at an angle of about 60 degrees. The labrum is sharply spear-shaped, about 1.2 times as long as wide, the apical hairs present, the lateral-apical hairs present or absent, the subapical hairs short and small. The apices of the mandibles are rather curved, the left mandible longer but mostly less than the head width and mostly shorter than half the head capsule, the mandibular condyle slightly projecting. The postmentum is slender and long, about eleven times as long as the waist width, the ratio of waist width to head width about 1:7–8, the waist constriction index 0.29–0.37. Antennae with 16 segments. The pronotum is about 1.5–1.7 times as wide as long, its anterior margin formed by two intersecting arcs, the lateral margins sharply oblique backwards, the posterior margin short and shallowly concave in the middle, with about thirty long bristles in the middle region.
taxonomy_note: The genus name is defective in the original work, printed as Reticuliter mes; it is in fact the genus Reticulitermes, the same genus name as currently used on this site.
